common.name: Name
common.noResultsHint: Try a different search or clear the filters.
common.unsavedDescription: Your changes on this page will be lost.
common.imageHint: Shown on the POS button next to the name. PNG, JPEG or WebP; it's resized automatically.
common.imageError: Couldn't use that image. Try another PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
common.translationsHint: Shown on the POS, receipts and lists when staff use Tamil or Sinhala. Leave blank to show the English name.

categories.caption: Categories
categories.deactivateDescription: It will be hidden from the POS and pickers. Products and history are kept.
categories.blockedDescription: It still has {{children}} active subcategories and {{products}} active products. Move or deactivate them first.
categories.emptyHint: Create the first category to start building your menu.
categories.detailsHint: Shown on POS buttons, receipts and reports.
categories.appearanceHint: Button colour on the Quick Pad. Locations can override it in Quick Pad Setup.
categories.parentHint: Leave empty for a top-level category.
categories.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first among siblings.

products.caption: Products
products.emptyHint: Add products, then choose where they're sold in Location Products.
products.detailsHint: Tenant-wide product master. Availability and price per location are set separately.
products.codeHint: SKU / PLU, unique in your business.
products.pricingHint: Base price applies wherever no location price is set.
products.barcodesHint: Scan with a barcode scanner or type and press Enter.
products.activeHint: Inactive products are hidden everywhere but kept for history.
products.notSoldAnywhere: Not sold at any location yet.

locationProducts.hint: Choose what this location sells and whether it's available right now.
locationProducts.caption: Products at {{location}}
locationProducts.availableHint: Turn off when out for the day. The button stays on the POS, greyed out.
locationProducts.settingsHint: How {{location}} prepares and charges for this item.
locationProducts.stationHint: Where the KOT prints and which kitchen display shows it.
locationProducts.serviceChargeHint: Adds the location's service charge when this item is sold here.

pricing.hint: Set the base price and location prices. Empty location cells use the base price.
pricing.caption: Price list
pricing.reasonDescription: Lowering a selling price needs a manager's PIN and a reason. It's recorded in the audit log.

quickPad.hint: Arrange category and product buttons for this location. Drag, or use the arrow buttons.
quickPad.noProducts: Nothing is sold here in this category.
quickPad.pickedUp: Picked up {{name}}. Use arrow keys to move, Space to drop.
quickPad.deviceInherits: {{device}} follows the location layout. Saving here creates a layout just for this device.
